text: Redmond Rovers push forward on the right flank, pressing high and moving the ball quickly near the halfway line on Ironvale Athletic’s end. They make five entries into the final third over the last eight minutes, holding 55% possession and controlling most of the territory in the attacking half. Rory Mensah takes a shot with his foot from outside the box, slightly to the left of the centre of the pitch, but it goes off target. Despite trailing 1-2, Redmond maintain pressure with a high defensive line, probing for openings against Ironvale’s deep defensive setup. [#1295]
